en.html:
Kageaki(That I do not want.)
Muramasa《Why? Mido, you like those machines, no?》
Kageaki(I do. But the only tsurugi I will wear is you.)
Muramasa《............》
Muramasa《What?》
Kageaki(—One lifetime, one work: that is the tsurugi smith. For the warrior also, one lifetime should mean one tsurugi.)

en.html:
Kageaki(My tsurugi is already decided. You. Another I have no intention of using.)
Muramasa《............》
Kageaki(Even so, you are telling me to use somebody else?)
Muramasa《Ah, um... Nahin. Sorry. Joking only... I was just grumbling.》
Muramasa《...Don't mind it, Mido. What I must do, I think I understand. Racing, whatever it is—if you tell me to enter, I'll enter. Enjoying it is another question...》
Muramasa《I am your tsurugi, after all.》
Kageaki(Yes. I am counting on you.)
Muramasa《............》

村正《あ、え……ううん。ごめんなさい。 　今のは冗談……ただ愚痴っただけ》
村正《……気にしないで、御堂。 　自分のやるべきことはわかっているつもり。 駆けっこでも何でも、貴方が出ろというなら 出るから。楽しくはないけれど……》
村正《私は貴方の劔冑なんだものね》
景明（ああ。 　頼む）
村正《…………》
